# Coal block

[All items](Items.md) · [Crafting guide](Crafting-Recipes.md) · [Home](Home.md)

[How to obtain](#how-to-obtain) · [Crafting and processing](#crafting-and-processing) · [Uses](#used-to-make)

<a href="Item-coal-block.md" title="Coal block"><img src="icons/65.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Coal block"></a>

A placeable storage block. Pack nine units into one block, then unpack it when you need the material again.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Furnace fuel duration | 800 seconds |
| Required mining tool | Wood pickaxe or better |
| Placement | Place from the hotbar |

## How to obtain

Make this item using the crafting or processing recipes below.

## Furnace fuel

One item supplies **800 seconds** of burning fuel. Use it in a [Furnace](Item-furnace.md) for smelting or cooking.
